self_description: I'm an INSEEC student in MSC Digital Supply Chain looking for a 24 months apprenticeship in September 2026.
description1: Interactive hangman game with visual interface using Pygame for graphics and animations
description2: My first web project - A digital transformation of my paper resume into an interactive HTML/CSS website with responsive design and modern styling.
description3: Complete recruitment platform with React frontend and Django REST API. Enables recruiters to post jobs and candidates to apply with JWT authentication.
description4: Java development of a 2D action-adventure game in the style of The Legend of Zelda, with enemy management, combat system, collisions, tile maps, and user interface. Unit testing with JUnit.
description5: Exciting new projects are in development. Stay tuned for updates!
description_background: Currently pursuing a professional transition into digital supply chain, I hold a DUT in Business Techniques and a professional bachelor’s degree in International Trade. My two years as a commercial assistant working with international brands strengthened my English proficiency, commercial awareness, and ability to adapt in multicultural environments.
description_why_tech: I initially began a transition into tech in September 2025 through a project-based program at Epitech, where I developed skills in programming, data analysis, and collaborative problem-solving. Although I had to end this program in February 2026 due to the lack of an apprenticeship opportunity, this experience confirmed my strong interest in digital transformation, analytical thinking, and continuous learning. Throughout my previous professional experiences, I also worked daily with data and operational coordination to support strategic business decisions, which naturally led me toward the digital and supply chain ecosystem.
description_today_section: Today, I am continuing this path by joining the MSc Digital Supply Chain, Purchasing & AI program at INSEEC. I am looking for an apprenticeship starting in September 2026 where I can combine my international business background, analytical mindset, and growing expertise in supply chain and digital tools. Curious, adaptable, and eager to keep learning, I thrive in dynamic environments that encourage collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
